name: context7
description: Context7 (Upstash) live library-docs registry. Query a library / framework / SDK name -> ranked registry records: Context7 ID (/org/project, also the docs-fetch key), description, trustScore (0-10), benchmark quality score (0-100), code-snippet + token counts, pinned doc versions, lastUpdateDate. STRUCTURE mode: answers 'which docs corpus exists for X, how fresh, which versions are indexed' with machine-readable quality metadata no page search returns cleanly; corpora update past training cutoff. NOTE: doc.url carries the Context7 ID path (e.g. /fastapi/fastapi; the API returns no absolute URL) — prepend https://context7.com for the browsable page, or pull curated current snippets: GET https://context7.com/api/v1/{id}?type=txt&topic={q}&tokens={n} (same quota). Keyless; 200 requests per calendar month per IP, shared across search + docs endpoints.
no_live_probe: 200 requests per calendar MONTH per IP, shared across search + docs. The watchdog probes daily (~30/mo) plus every 6h (~120/mo), which would burn ~150 of the 200 on health checks alone and mark the source down for an exhaustion OmniSeek itself caused. Measured 2026-07-25: context7 was in watchdog_down for exactly this. Breakage now surfaces at use time (this row is named-drill only, and a named drill emits the /eye-fix diagnostic).
explicit_only: anonymous quota is 200 requests per calendar month per IP, shared across Context7 search + docs endpoints; call by name only, keep out of broad sweeps and standing sensors (health probes also spend quota)

name: federal_register
description: US Federal Register keyless JSON API (federalregister.gov/api/v1). Full-text term search over the daily journal of the US government: proposed and final Rules, Notices, and Presidential Documents (executive orders, proclamations). Each hit carries title, document type (Rule / Proposed Rule / Notice / Presidential Document), abstract, the issuing agency, publication_date, the federalregister.gov article URL, and a govinfo PDF. order=newest, so an empty query browses the latest documents and a term query returns the newest matching ones. POLICY / MONITOR: the primary-source US rulemaking record (AI executive orders, BIS export-control rules, NIST and Commerce actions, agency AI notices). Keyless and public; keep pages small and be polite. Complements open web search with the structured, faceted rulemaking record no page scrape returns cleanly.
explicit_only: federal_register: named drill only. MEASURED 2026-07-25 over 1986 recorded searches: timed out 727 times (37% of all searches) and reached the ranked top-k ZERO times, sole-contributed ZERO times. US federal regulatory filings sit outside the CA/SG/HK + AI-research queries this eye serves, and cset / oecd_ai_policy already carry AI policy. Kept fully reachable by name; excluded_relevant still recommends it on a real match. Captain's call 2026-07-25.
